objective: Prove the existing Control Room conversation projection pattern on a second materially different recovered chat before generalizing it.
findings: The first projection works for the Ideas recovery record.
The cloned projection works for a deep-read STT recovery record without creating a new model/backend/authority.
The STT clone initially exposed that sparse INDEX metadata is insufficient for rich card content; fetching the existing detailed recovery entry solved it without schema expansion.
Both canaries retain existing Search/Adopt semantics.
The remaining global V11 failure is downstream and unrelated: Notes exact-back / null semantic_registry.
decision: Abstraction is now earned. The next bounded stage is to replace the two canary-specific adapters with one generic recovery projection driven by existing metadata, preserving the same authority boundary.
